snippet.title: Day Seven - Psychological PSX horror
snippet.description:
DAY 7 (2019) -Every 20 seconds, a person goes missing in the US. 
Terrence has been slowly losing his mind at a dead end job. His desolate late night commute may make him lose a lot more than that

PSX style, Hellnight inspired survival horror

Get it now: http://patreon.com/puppetcombo
